

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="de">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>ANARKHEL · Fliesenleger Meisterbetrieb · Halle (Saale)</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Cinzel:wght@500;600;700&family=Dancing+Script:wght@600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
  --navy:#1e2a3a;
  --navy-deep:#141d28;
  --gold:#b08d4f;
  --gold-light:#c9a86a;
  --marble:#f4f2ee;
  --marble-white:#fbfaf8;
  --ink:#2a2f38;
  --grey:#6b7280;
}
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{
  font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;
  color:var(--ink);
  background:var(--marble-white);
  font-size:18px;
  line-height:1.6;
  overflow-x:hidden;
  width:100%;
}
section,header,footer{max-width:100vw;overflow-x:hidden}
.marble-bg{
  background:
    linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,255,255,.4),rgba(244,242,238,.25)),
    url(data:image/jpeg;base64,);
  background-size:cover;
}
.gold-line{height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--gold),transparent)}

/* ---- Eckdekoration: 3 Lagen wie auf der Visitenkarte ---- */
/* dunkler Marmor (navy+gold) + dünne Goldlinie + heller Marmor */
.corner{position:absolute;width:300px;height:300px;pointer-events:none;z-index:1;overflow:hidden}
.corner-tl{top:0;left:0}
.corner-br{bottom:0;right:0;transform:rotate(180deg)}
/* Lage 1: dunkler Marmor mit Goldadern */
.corner::before{
  content:"";position:absolute;top:-80px;left:-90px;width:380px;height:200px;
  background:url(data:image/jpeg;base64,);
  background-size:cover;background-position:center;
  transform:rotate(-32deg);
  box-shadow:inset 20px 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.4);
}
/* Lage 2: dünne Goldlinie */
.corner::after{
  content:"";position:absolute;top:78px;left:-90px;width:400px;height:0;
  border-top:2px solid var(--gold);
  filter:drop-shadow(0 1px 1px rgba(176,141,79,.4));
  transform:rotate(-32deg);transform-origin:left;
}
/* Lage 3: heller Marmor */
.corner i{
  content:"";position:absolute;top:84px;left:-90px;width:400px;height:120px;
  background:url(data:image/jpeg;base64,);
  background-size:cover;background-position:center;
  transform:rotate(-32deg);transform-origin:left;
  box-shadow:inset 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.12);
}
.dots{position:absolute;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,5px);gap:8px;z-index:2}
.dots span{width:4px;height:4px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold);opacity:.55}

/* ---------- Logo ---------- */
.logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px}
.logo-mark{position:relative;width:64px;height:64px;flex-shrink:0;border:1.5px solid var(--gold);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.tiles{position:relative;width:38px;height:38px;transform:translate(-2px,-2px)}
.tile{position:absolute;width:17px;height:17px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#2b3a4d,#0f1620);box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
.tile:nth-child(1){top:0;left:0}
.tile:nth-child(2){top:0;left:19px}
.tile:nth-child(3){top:19px;left:0}
.tile:nth-child(4){top:19px;left:19px}
.trowel{position:absolute;right:-12px;bottom:-6px;width:26px;height:14px;background:var(--navy);clip-path:polygon(0 35%,75% 0,100% 30%,100% 70%,0 100%);}
.trowel::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:2px;top:4px;width:18px;height:6px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gold) 0 1px,transparent 1px 4px)}
.logo-text{line-height:1}
.logo-name{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-weight:700;font-size:1.7rem;letter-spacing:.18em;color:var(--navy)}
.logo-sub{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.32em;color:var(--gold);margin-top:4px}

/* ---------- Header ---------- */
header{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:50;background:rgba(251,250,248,.88);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(176,141,79,.25);transition:.3s}
.nav{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;padding:14px 28px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
.nav .logo-mark{width:48px;height:48px}
.nav .tiles{width:28px;height:28px}
.nav .tile{width:12px;height:12px}.nav .tile:nth-child(2){left:14px}.nav .tile:nth-child(3){top:14px}.nav .tile:nth-child(4){top:14px;left:14px}
.nav .logo-name{font-size:1.2rem}.nav .logo-sub{font-size:.5rem}
.nav-links{display:flex;gap:34px;list-style:none}
.nav-links a{text-decoration:none;color:var(--navy);font-size:1.05rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.04em;position:relative;transition:.25s}
.nav-links a::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;bottom:-4px;width:0;height:1px;background:var(--gold);transition:.3s}
.nav-links a:hover{color:var(--gold)}.nav-links a:hover::after{width:100%}
.burger{display:none;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;cursor:pointer}
.burger span{width:26px;height:2px;background:var(--navy)}

/* ---------- Hero ---------- */
.hero{position:relative;min-height:100vh;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;padding:120px 24px 60px}
.hero-inner{position:relative;z-index:5;max-width:820px;opacity:0;transform:translateY(30px);animation:rise 1s .2s forwards}
@keyframes rise{to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.hero .logo{justify-content:center;margin-bottom:30px}
.hero .logo-mark{width:80px;height:80px}
.hero .tiles{width:46px;height:46px}
.hero .tile{width:21px;height:21px}.hero .tile:nth-child(2){left:23px}.hero .tile:nth-child(3){top:23px}.hero .tile:nth-child(4){top:23px;left:23px}
.hero .logo-name{font-size:2.6rem}
.hero h1{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:clamp(2.2rem,6vw,4rem);color:var(--navy);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.05em;margin:10px 0 6px}
.hero .script{font-family:'Dancing Script',cursive;font-size:clamp(1.4rem,4vw,2.2rem);color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:24px}
.hero p.lead{font-size:1.25rem;color:var(--grey);max-width:560px;margin:0 auto 36px}
.btn{display:inline-block;text-decoration:none;font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:.95rem;letter-spacing:.12em;padding:16px 38px;transition:.3s;cursor:pointer;border:none}
.btn-gold{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold),var(--gold-light));color:#fff;box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(176,141,79,.35)}
.btn-gold:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(176,141,79,.5)}
.btn-outline{background:transparent;color:var(--navy);border:1.5px solid var(--navy);margin-left:14px}
.btn-outline:hover{background:var(--navy);color:#fff}
.scroll-ind{position:absolute;bottom:28px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:5;color:var(--gold);font-size:1.6rem;animation:bob 1.8s infinite}
@keyframes bob{0%,100%{transform:translate(-50%,0)}50%{transform:translate(-50%,10px)}}

/* ---------- Sections ---------- */
section{position:relative}
.wrap{max-width:1160px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 28px}
.sec-pad{padding:110px 0}
.sec-head{text-align:center;margin-bottom:64px}
.sec-head .script{font-family:'Dancing Script',cursive;color:var(--gold);font-size:1.7rem}
.sec-head h2{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:clamp(1.8rem,4vw,2.6rem);color:var(--navy);letter-spacing:.06em;margin:6px 0 16px}
.diamond{display:inline-block;width:8px;height:8px;background:var(--gold);transform:rotate(45deg);margin:0 6px}

/* Leistungen */
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:26px}
.card{background:var(--marble-white);border:1px solid rgba(176,141,79,.3);padding:38px 30px;position:relative;transition:.35s;overflow:hidden}
.card::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:3px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gold),transparent);transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:.4s}
.card:hover{transform:translateY(-8px);box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(30,42,58,.12);border-color:var(--gold)}
.card:hover::before{transform:scaleX(1)}
.card .icon{font-size:2rem;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:14px}
.card h3{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;color:var(--navy);font-size:1.2rem;letter-spacing:.04em;margin-bottom:10px}
.card p{color:var(--grey);font-size:1.05rem}

/* Warum / Vorteile */
.why{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--navy-deep),var(--navy));color:#fff;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.why .sec-head h2{color:#fff}
.why-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(200px,1fr));gap:30px}
.why-item{text-align:center;padding:20px}
.why-item .num{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:2.6rem;color:var(--gold);display:block;margin-bottom:8px}
.why-item h4{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:1.1rem;letter-spacing:.05em;margin-bottom:8px}
.why-item p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);font-size:1rem}

/* Liste / Leistungsumfang */
.two-col{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:60px;align-items:start}
.list-block h3{font-family:'Dancing Script',cursive;color:var(--gold);font-size:1.8rem;margin-bottom:6px}
.gold-divider{width:50px;height:2px;background:var(--gold);margin-bottom:22px;position:relative}
.gold-divider::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:-7px;top:-3px;width:8px;height:8px;background:var(--gold);transform:rotate(45deg)}
.check-list{list-style:none}
.check-list li{padding:11px 0 11px 34px;position:relative;font-size:1.15rem;border-bottom:1px dashed rgba(176,141,79,.25)}
.check-list li::before{content:"✓";position:absolute;left:0;color:var(--gold);font-weight:700}

/* Kontakt */
.contact{background:var(--marble);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.contact-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:50px;align-items:center}
.contact-info p{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;font-size:1.2rem;margin-bottom:18px;color:var(--navy)}
.contact-info .ci-icon{width:42px;height:42px;flex-shrink:0;border:1px solid var(--gold);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--gold);font-size:1.1rem}
.form{background:#fff;padding:40px;border:1px solid rgba(176,141,79,.3);box-shadow:0 14px 40px rgba(30,42,58,.08)}
.form input,.form textarea{width:100%;padding:14px 16px;margin-bottom:16px;border:1px solid #d8d3c8;background:var(--marble-white);font-family:inherit;font-size:1.05rem;color:var(--ink);transition:.25s}
.form input:focus,.form textarea:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(176,141,79,.12)}
.form .btn-gold{width:100%}

/* Footer */
footer{background:var(--navy-deep);color:rgba(255,255,255,.65);text-align:center;padding:50px 24px 30px}
footer .logo{justify-content:center;margin-bottom:18px}
footer .logo-name{color:#fff}
footer .f-links{display:flex;gap:24px;justify-content:center;list-style:none;margin:18px 0;flex-wrap:wrap}
footer .f-links a{color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);text-decoration:none;font-size:1rem;transition:.25s}
footer .f-links a:hover{color:var(--gold)}
footer .copy{font-size:.9rem;opacity:.6;margin-top:14px}

/* Reveal animation */
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(40px);transition:.8s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}
.reveal.in{opacity:1;transform:none}

@media(max-width:820px){
  .nav-links{position:fixed;top:0;right:-100%;flex-direction:column;background:var(--marble-white);height:100vh;width:70%;padding:100px 40px;gap:26px;box-shadow:-10px 0 30px rgba(0,0,0,.1);transition:.4s;z-index:60}
  .nav-links.open{right:0}
  .burger{display:flex}
  .two-col,.contact-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:34px}
  .btn-outline{margin-left:0;margin-top:12px}
}
@media(max-width:600px){
  body{font-size:16px}
  /* Ecken kleiner + abgeschnitten, damit nichts übersteht */
  .corner{width:150px;height:150px}
  .corner::before{top:-50px;left:-55px;width:220px;height:120px}
  .corner::after{top:46px;left:-55px;width:230px}
  .corner i{top:50px;left:-55px;width:230px;height:75px}
  .dots{display:none}
  /* Hero kleiner */
  .hero{padding:110px 18px 80px}
  .hero .logo{flex-direction:column;gap:10px;text-align:center}
  .hero .logo-name{font-size:1.9rem}
  .hero h1{font-size:2rem;letter-spacing:.02em}
  .hero .script{font-size:1.3rem}
  .hero p.lead{font-size:1.05rem}
  .btn{display:block;width:100%;text-align:center;padding:15px 20px}
  .btn-outline{margin:12px 0 0}
  .sec-pad{padding:70px 0}
  .sec-head h2{font-size:1.7rem}
  .logo-name{font-size:1.4rem}
  .logo-sub{font-size:.45rem;letter-spacing:.22em}
  .nav .logo-name{font-size:1.05rem}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<header>
  <div class="nav">
    <div class="logo">
      <div class="logo-mark"><div class="tiles"><span class="tile"></span><span class="tile"></span><span class="tile"></span><span class="tile"></span><span class="trowel"></span></div></div>
      <div class="logo-text"><div class="logo-name">ANARKHEL</div><div class="logo-sub">FLIESENLEGER MEISTERBETRIEB</div></div>
    </div>
    <ul class="nav-links" id="navLinks">
      <li><a href="#start">Start</a></li>
      <li><a href="#leistungen">Leistungen</a></li>
      <li><a href="#warum">Warum wir</a></li>
      <li><a href="#kontakt">Kontakt</a></li>
    </ul>
    <div class="burger" id="burger"><span></span><span></span><span></span></div>
  </div>
</header>

<!-- HERO -->
<section class="hero marble-bg" id="start">
  <div class="corner corner-tl"><i></i></div>
  <div class="corner corner-br"><i></i></div>
  <div class="dots" style="top:120px;right:60px"><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span></div>
  <div class="dots" style="bottom:120px;left:60px"><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span></div>
  <div class="hero-inner">
    <div class="logo">
      <div class="logo-mark"><div class="tiles"><span class="tile"></span><span class="tile"></span><span class="tile"></span><span class="tile"></span><span class="trowel"></span></div></div>
      <div class="logo-text"><div class="logo-name">ANARKHEL</div><div class="logo-sub">FLIESENLEGER MEISTERBETRIEB</div></div>
    </div>
    <h1>Fliesen mit Stil</h1>
    <div class="script">Halle (Saale) &amp; Umgebung</div>
    <p class="lead">Ihr Meisterbetrieb für Fliesen, Naturstein und Komplettsanierung – saubere Arbeit, faire Preise, termintreu.</p>
    <a href="#kontakt" class="btn btn-gold">Kostenloses Angebot</a>
    <a href="#leistungen" class="btn btn-outline">Leistungen</a>
  </div>
  <div class="scroll-ind">❖</div>
</section>

<!-- LEISTUNGEN -->
<section class="sec-pad" id="leistungen">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-head reveal">
      <div class="script">Unsere Leistungen</div>
      <h2>Was wir für Sie tun<span class="diamond"></span></h2>
      <div class="gold-line" style="max-width:280px;margin:0 auto"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="grid">
      <div class="card reveal"><div class="icon">▦</div><h3>Fliesen &amp; Platten</h3><p>Boden- und Wandfliesen, Mosaik – präzise verlegt für ein makelloses Ergebnis.</p></div>
      <div class="card reveal"><div class="icon">⬒</div><h3>Bad-Komplettsanierung</h3><p>Ihr Badezimmer aus einer Hand – von der Planung bis zum letzten Silikonzug.</p></div>
      <div class="card reveal"><div class="icon">◧</div><h3>Naturstein &amp; Großformat</h3><p>Edle Natursteine und großformatige Fliesen für eine hochwertige Optik.</p></div>
      <div class="card reveal"><div class="icon">◇</div><h3>Abdichtung &amp; Silikon</h3><p>Fachgerechte Abdichtung und saubere Silikonarbeiten gegen Feuchtigkeit.</p></div>
      <div class="card reveal"><div class="icon">⬚</div><h3>Altfliesen entfernen</h3><p>Schnelles, sauberes Entfernen alter Fliesen und Estrichvorbereitung.</p></div>
      <div class="card reveal"><div class="icon">✦</div><h3>Reparatur &amp; Ausbesserung</h3><p>Kleine Schäden professionell ausgebessert – unauffällig und langlebig.</p></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- WARUM -->
<section class="why sec-pad" id="warum">
  <div class="corner corner-tl"><i></i></div>
  <div class="corner corner-br"><i></i></div>
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-head reveal">
      <div class="script">Warum Anarkhel?</div>
      <h2>Ihre Vorteile<span class="diamond"></span></h2>
    </div>
    <div class="why-grid">
      <div class="why-item reveal"><span class="num">✓</span><h4>Meisterbetrieb</h4><p>Qualität nach Meisterstandard – geprüft und zuverlässig.</p></div>
      <div class="why-item reveal"><span class="num">✓</span><h4>Saubere Arbeit</h4><p>Schnell und ordentlich, ohne Chaos auf Ihrer Baustelle.</p></div>
      <div class="why-item reveal"><span class="num">✓</span><h4>Faire Preise</h4><p>Transparente Angebote ohne versteckte Kosten.</p></div>
      <div class="why-item reveal"><span class="num">✓</span><h4>Termintreu</h4><p>Wir halten, was wir versprechen – pünktlich fertig.</p></div>
      <div class="why-item reveal"><span class="num">✓</span><h4>Zufriedene Kunden</h4><p>Zahlreiche zufriedene Auftraggeber in der Region.</p></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- LEISTUNGSUMFANG LISTE -->
<section class="sec-pad marble-bg">
  <div class="wrap two-col">
    <div class="list-block reveal">
      <h3>Komplettes Leistungsspektrum</h3>
      <div class="gold-divider"></div>
      <ul class="check-list">
        <li>Bad-Komplettsanierung</li>
        <li>Fliesen (Boden &amp; Wand)</li>
        <li>Großformat &amp; Naturstein</li>
        <li>Abdichtung &amp; Silikonarbeiten</li>
        <li>Altfliesen entfernen</li>
        <li>Reparatur &amp; Ausbesserung</li>
        <li>Estrichvorbereitung</li>
      </ul>
    </div>
    <div class="list-block reveal">
      <h3>Unser Versprechen</h3>
      <div class="gold-divider"></div>
      <ul class="check-list">
        <li>Persönliche Beratung vor Ort</li>
        <li>Kostenloses, unverbindliches Angebot</li>
        <li>Hochwertige Materialien</li>
        <li>Garantie auf alle Arbeiten</li>
        <li>Flexible Terminvergabe</li>
        <li>Halle (Saale) &amp; Umgebung</li>
      </ul>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- KONTAKT -->
<section class="contact sec-pad" id="kontakt">
  <div class="corner corner-tl"><i></i></div>
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-head reveal">
      <div class="script">Jetzt anfragen</div>
      <h2>Kostenloses Angebot<span class="diamond"></span></h2>
    </div>
    <div class="contact-grid">
      <div class="contact-info reveal">
        <p><span class="ci-icon">✆</span> 0176 / XXX XXX XXX</p>
        <p><span class="ci-icon">✉</span> anarkhel@email.de</p>
        <p><span class="ci-icon">⌖</span> Halle (Saale) &amp; Umgebung</p>
        <div class="gold-line" style="margin:20px 0"></div>
        <p style="font-family:'Dancing Script',cursive;color:var(--gold);font-size:1.5rem">Jetzt kostenloses Angebot anfordern!</p>
      </div>
      <div class="form reveal">
        <input type="text" placeholder="Ihr Name">
        <input type="tel" placeholder="Telefonnummer">
        <input type="email" placeholder="E-Mail">
        <textarea rows="4" placeholder="Ihre Nachricht / Projekt"></textarea>
        <button class="btn btn-gold" onclick="alert('Vielen Dank! Wir melden uns in Kürze.')">Anfrage senden</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<footer>
  <div class="logo">
    <div class="logo-mark"><div class="tiles"><span class="tile"></span><span class="tile"></span><span class="tile"></span><span class="tile"></span><span class="trowel"></span></div></div>
    <div class="logo-text"><div class="logo-name">ANARKHEL</div><div class="logo-sub">FLIESENLEGER MEISTERBETRIEB</div></div>
  </div>
  <ul class="f-links">
    <li><a href="#start">Start</a></li>
    <li><a href="#leistungen">Leistungen</a></li>
    <li><a href="#warum">Warum wir</a></li>
    <li><a href="#kontakt">Kontakt</a></li>
  </ul>
  <p>Halle (Saale) &amp; Umgebung · 0176 / XXX XXX XXX · anarkhel@email.de</p>
  <p class="copy">© 2026 Anarkhel Fliesenleger Meisterbetrieb · Alle Rechte vorbehalten</p>
</footer>

<script>
const burger=document.getElementById('burger'),navLinks=document.getElementById('navLinks');
burger.addEventListener('click',()=>navLinks.classList.toggle('open'));
navLinks.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(a=>a.addEventListener('click',()=>navLinks.classList.remove('open')));
const obs=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting)e.target.classList.add('in')}),{threshold:.15});
document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach((el,i)=>{el.style.transitionDelay=(i%3*0.08)+'s';obs.observe(el)});
</script>
</body>
</html>
